The versioned NotificationPolicy document (ADR 0017). Version 0 is the built-in default: every family NOBODY, nothing delivered. The document decides the notifier stamp of every ShopperNoticeDecided fact; the notice itself is delivered outside the network (the marketplace notifier is the storefront consuming the event).
